pool.message: it’s just so quiet. i never realized how loud the silence would be without him here. everything just feels... empty. like there's no point in even waking up tomorrow.
i just feel like im playing a game where everyone else has the rulebook and im just guessing. it's so tiring pretending to be a person that actually fits in. i dont think i ever will.
i feel like i'm just empty. i used to have so much to say, so much color... but now it's just gone. i look at my work and it's all just noise. i think i've finally run out of things to give.
idk i just feel like i've tried everything and nothing changes. it feels like im just running on a treadmill that never stops and i'm just so incredibly tired of existing like this.

it's just so quiet here today. i was looking at my hands earlier and they don't even feel like mine anymore. everything is just slowing down and slipping away. i feel like i'm just taking up space while i wait for the clock to run out.

i don't know why i'm even trying anymore. everything just feels so pointless and heavy. like there's no real reason to keep pushing through it all when nothing actually changes. feels like i'm just spinning my wheels in a void.
i rly dont know what to do anymore. i did everything i could for him but he still died... i feel like a total failure. i'm so tired of everything. i just want to sleep and not wake up.

i just feel so tired. like, every single day is just this massive effort to pretend i'm someone i'm not just so people don't look at me weird. it's never gonna stop, is it? the fighting, the hiding... i don't think i have the energy to keep doing this anymore.

i dont even know how to keep going. the debt is just... it's a mountain. every time i think i've made progress i just sink deeper. i feel like i'm drowning and there's no way out. it's just a cycle that never ends and i'm so tired of fighting it.
i feel like i've just hit a wall. everything that's happened... it's just too much. i dont think there's anything left of me to fix. i'm just fundamentally broken at this point.

i feel like im just walking through this thick fog for so long now. the path used to be clear, but lately everything is just grey and heavy. i've reached this edge where the trail just... stops. there's nothing left to walk on, just a long drop into nothingness. it feels like the journey was never meant to go any further.
